entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I'm calling about an order. I think I need to return something, but I'm just so confused by the website. I don't know what to do.
I can definitely help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a helmet. I ordered it for my husband, but the color is all wrong. It looked much darker on the website. The box is still unopened. I'm just overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. No need to worry. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied with your gear, especially when it comes to safety. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your name, please?
Thank you, Maria. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Granite Peak helmet, delivered on November 16th. That was 24 days ago.
Is that bad? I was so busy I didn't get to it. I'm sorry.
Not at all. Let me check our return policy for you... Okay, I see here that standard items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the timeframe.
Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief.
I've gone ahead and approved the return. I am sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file for you now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah. That was so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
